title: Good product
text: Good product. I was really hoping this would work for me but it doesn't. My bed is not high enough and this lays on the floor. Will be returning it. But seems to be well made.

product_metadata.title: MINDFULL Bedside Caddy, 7 Storage Pockets with Power Strip Compartment, Gray
features: This ultimate bedside organizer conveniently stores all of your personal items on your bedside or couchside while you are resting or relaxing
Featuring 2 large pockets to store laptops, tablets, phones, books, magazines and 7 mesh pockets to store smartphones, remotes, eye glasses, and more
Conveniently plug in all your devices into the power strip stowed in the power strip compartment (power strip not included)
Simply tuck the flap with rubberized grips under your matress, slide a standard 6 outlet power strip into the bottom power strip compartment, and it's ready to use
Constructed of industrial grade materials with reinforced seams to ensure long term use
description: This ultimate bedside organizer conveniently stores all of your personal items on your bedside or couch side while you are resting or relaxing. The Mindfull Products Bedside Caddy is the perfect organizer for smartphones, tablets, remotes and other home accessories, keeping your crucial gadgets readily available. Conveniently plug in all your devices into the power strip stowed in the power strip compartment (power strip not included) to ensure each gadget is fully charged while you sleep. Bedside pocket organizers are a perfect additon to dorm rooms, living rooms, couches, bedrooms and more. Stay organized with Mindfull Products!
